    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Find the non-background motif and the rectangular placeholder region.

             if g[r][c] != bg]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    motif = [row[c0:c1+1] for row in g[r0:r1+1]]
    h, w = len(motif), len(motif[0])
    other = Counter(x for row in g for x in row if x != bg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0]))
           if g[r][c] == other]
    # The placeholder is the contiguous rectangle of the color distinct from the motif/background.
    z = Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common()
    placeholder = next((v for v, n in z if v != bg and v != other), None)
    if placeholder is None:
        placeholder = min((x for x in z if x[0] != bg), key=lambda x: x[1])[0]
    ps = [(r, c) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0]))

    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    zeros = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, x in enumerate(row) if x == 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in zeros), max(r for r, c in zeros)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in zeros), max(c for r, c in zeros)

    motif_cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, x in enumerate(row)
                   if x != bg and x != 0]
    mr0 = min(r for r, c in motif_cells)
    mr1 = max(r for r, c in motif_cells)
    mc0 = min(c for r, c in motif_cells)
    mc1 = max(c for r, c in motif_cells)
    motif = [g[r][mc0:mc1+1] for r in range(mr0, mr1+1)]

            g[r0+i][c0+j] = motif[i][j]

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter

    bg = Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Locate the solid placeholder rectangle (color 0).
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)

    # The colored pattern on the background, excluding the placeholder.
    pattern = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row)
               if v != bg and v != 0]
    pr0, pr1 = min(r for r, c in pattern), max(r for r, c in pattern)
    pc0, pc1 = min(c for r, c in pattern), max(c for r, c in pattern)
    motif = [g[r][pc0:pc1+1] for r in range(pr0, pr1+1)]

    # Copy the motif into the placeholder, reflected left-to-right.
    for i, row in enumerate(motif):
        for j, value in enumerate(row):
            g[r0+i][c0+j] = row[len(row)-1-j]
    return g
